behavior: Project B before explicitly opening its panel
actual: Native window switched to WORKSPACE_B, whose autoShowPanel setting was false. No webview target existed. A chained helper command incorrectly proceeded to subsequent webview calls after the first target-validation failure.
helperErrorExact: Native webview target is not unique (0).
resolution: Stop the invalid sequence; retain its observations. Explicitly open the B panel through the native workbench command. Subsequent action wrappers stop immediately on a nonzero helper exit; do not repeat the absent-webview calls.
mediaDisposition: The two pre-panel screenshots remain local, excluded from publication and not treated as office or Squad Info evidence.
